scope_v1: compute remaining ingredient burden recursively through recipe chains; include direct and indirect demand; distinguish effective outputs from craft operations; apply relevant crafting/mastery rules and modifiers from BL-031, BL-032, and BL-033 rather than hardcoding only a fixed saver formula; support goal scopes M, GM, MM, and Tower; support Tower-specific analysis for a selected tower target or cutoff rather than only whole-tower totals; expose app-facing results that can later power lookup and list views

Tower scope supports a selected level cutoff and dedupes repeated rows to the highest required threshold per item within that cutoff.

notes: Keep this graph/model loader local-only and warning-tolerant. The output should be app-facing planning data, not a replacement for the raw backlog file or a reason to make planning files general runtime reference data.
